what: FYI (no action needed unless you object): added the v2 test fixture to hir-expand: crates/hir-expand/src/fixture.rs (+ fixture/tests.rs), `#[cfg(any(test, feature = "fixture"))] pub mod fixture;` in lib.rs, and in Cargo.toml optional deps blaze-vfs + test-utils behind a new `fixture` feature (also dev-deps). It replaces crates/test-fixture (being deleted): `hir_expand::fixture::db(text) -> Fixture` sets the files as views (Db::set_view_root), the crate graph by CrateGraphBuilder::set_in_db and proc macros by ProcMacrosBuilder::build_in. Other crates take it as `hir-expand = { workspace = true, features = ["fixture"] }` in [dev-dependencies]. Please keep it when editing lib.rs/Cargo.toml.
